skill_description: Ouroboros spec-first workflow (ooo / interview / spec / Seed / evaluation / evolution). Load this skill before you start acting.
skill_when_to_use: Use when the user says ooo… or /ooo…, asks for spec-before-implementation, wants an idea turned into a spec, or wants self-evaluation/evolution.
guard_reason: Load skill ooo first, finish the interview, and lock a Seed; this project has no locked Seed yet.

tools.ooo_interview: One interview round: record the answer, score deterministically, ask the next question.
tools.ooo_seed: Nine gates + restate approval + validation + lock the Seed.
tools.ooo_run: Dispatch one execution subagent per AC and collect artifacts.
tools.ooo_evaluate: Stage1 mechanical / Stage2 semantic / Stage3 consensus + deterministic verdict.
tools.ooo_evolve: Evolution loop with the convergence criteria.
